---
title: "flexdashboard"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)

data("ny_noaa")

weather_data =
  ny_noaa |>
  filter(id == "USW00094728") |>
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(format(date, "%Y")),
    month = factor(month.abb[as.integer(format(date, "%m"))],
                   levels = month.abb),
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    prcp = as.numeric(prcp) / 10
  ) |>
  filter(year >= 2006, year <= 2010)
```


```{r scatter-plot}
weather_data |>
  filter(!is.na(tmax), !is.na(tmin)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~tmin,
    y = ~tmax,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    color = ~prcp,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Minimum Temperature (°C)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Maximum Temperature (°C)")
  )
```


```{r box-plot}
weather_data |>
  filter(!is.na(tmax)) |>
  plot_ly(
    y = ~tmax,
    color = ~month,
    type = "box"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Maximum Temperature (°C)")
  )
```


```{r bar-plot}
weather_data |>
  filter(prcp > 0) |>
  count(month) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~month,
    y = ~n,
    type = "bar"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Rainy Days (2006–2010 Total)")
  )
```
